entity.label: Legal entity
entity.configured: Legal entities and cost centres are configured by administration.

scopeLimited: You see part of this entity only (your cost centres). Totals for the whole entity are withheld, not recalculated.

provisional.title: Partly built (Gate E.8, provisional)
provisional.suppliers: Suppliers, their bills and payment instructions work in this demo. Bank details of new suppliers are verified by administration later.
provisional.supplier: Purchase orders and contracts arrive with procurement (E.9). Posting waits on E.7's posting rules (E-⁠17); settlement waits on decision E-⁠18.
provisional.bills: Approval works with a second person. Posting waits on E.7's posting rules (E-⁠17); settlement waits on decision E-⁠18.
provisional.bill: Posting to the ledger is planned (E.7 posting rules, E-⁠17). A payment instruction is not a settlement (E-⁠18).
provisional.newBill: The three-⁠way match with a goods receipt (PROC-⁠008) arrives with procurement (E.9).
provisional.payments: Instructions only: no bank, no transfer, no settlement until decision E-⁠18.
provisional.ledger: Settled payments and credit notes reduce the balance once E-⁠18 and credit notes exist; neither exists yet.
provisional.utilities: Utility bills follow the supplier bill rules. Nothing is paid automatically.
provisional.expenses: Approval works with a second person. Posting waits on E.7's posting rules (E-⁠17); reimbursement and payment wait on decision E-⁠18.
provisional.newExpense: The receipt is a demo document reference; document storage arrives with E.13.
provisional.expense: Posting is planned (E.7 posting rules, E-⁠17); payment or reimbursement waits on decision E-⁠18.
provisional.approvals: Expense and claim approvals work here; bills are approved on their own page. Policy thresholds (APR-⁠004) open to developers with decision E-⁠27.
provisional.pettyCash: Counts are witnessed by a second person; top-⁠ups are instructions only (E-⁠18).
provisional.employee: Claims link to staff sign-⁠ins; the HR employee record and its Employee 360 tab arrive with E.14.
provisional.budgets: Budget versions are approved by a second person and never edited in place.
provisional.budget: Budget versions are approved by a second person and never edited in place.
provisional.bva: Actual means posted, and nothing can be posted until E.7's posting rules (E-⁠17). Commitments from purchase orders arrive with E.9.
provisional.fictional: All suppliers, documents, accounts and amounts are fictional demo data.

boundary.title: Approved, posted and settled are three different things
boundary.approval: Approving a bill or expense makes it an obligation. It is not paid.
boundary.posting: Posting to the ledger is planned: it waits on E.7's posting rules (E-⁠17).
boundary.settlement: A payment instruction asks for payment. It counts as settled only on bank evidence (E-⁠18), which this prototype does not have yet. Nothing here is ever shown as paid.
boundary.short: Approved = an obligation, not paid. Posting is planned (E-⁠17). Settlement needs bank evidence (E-⁠18).

paidVia.payable: To be paid to the payee (an obligation)

bank.hidden: Bank details need the bank permission

evidence.label: Evidence (demo document)
evidence.hint: Attach the bill or receipt, or use the labelled sample. The prototype keeps only the file's name.

blocked.own_bill: You prepared or submitted this bill, so someone else approves it.
blocked.own_instruction: You prepared this instruction, so someone else approves it.
blocked.own_expense: You recorded or submitted this, so someone else decides it.
blocked.own_claim: This is your own claim: someone else decides it.
blocked.own_count: You counted this cash, so someone else witnesses the count.
blocked.own_request: You requested this top-⁠up, so someone else approves it.
blocked.own_version: You prepared this version, so someone else approves it.
blocked.no_permission: Waiting for someone who may approve it.

history.bill_approved: Approved bill {{ref}} ({{amount}}): an obligation, not paid

errors.category: Choose a category from the list.
errors.kind: Choose a kind from the list.
errors.service: Choose a utility service from the list.
errors.paidVia: Choose how it is to be paid.
errors.year: Choose a fiscal year from the list.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number, digits only (spaces and a leading + are fine).
errors.duplicateCategory: Each category appears once per version.
errors.unknownSupplier: Choose a supplier from your list.
errors.unknownCostCentre: Choose a cost centre from your list.
errors.unknownProject: Choose a project of this entity.
errors.unknownFloat: Choose a petty-⁠cash float from your list.
errors.unknownClaimant: Choose a staff member from the list.
errors.floatCostCentre: The float must belong to the expense's cost centre.
errors.crossEntity: This belongs to another legal entity.

errors.evidenceRequired: Attach the bill or receipt before submitting.
errors.aboveInstructable: This is more than is left to instruct on the bill ({{amount}}).

errors.aboveImprest: A top-⁠up cannot be more than the authorised float ({{amount}}).
errors.notes: Enter whole numbers of notes (0 or more).

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.intro: The suppliers of each legal entity, with their bills waiting for approval and what is owed to them.
suppliers.noneHint: Suppliers you may see appear here.
suppliers.name: Supplier name
suppliers.bankLater: Bank details of a new supplier are recorded and verified by administration later. Until then no payment instruction can be prepared for it.

supplier.title: Supplier 360
supplier.inProgressCount: Bills in progress (draft or awaiting approval)
supplier.ordersPlannedBody: Purchase orders, goods receipts and the three-⁠way match are planned for Gate E.9.
supplier.contractsPlannedBody: Contracts arrive with procurement (E.9) and documents (E.13).
supplier.ledgerIntro: The ledger lists approved bills; settled payments and credit notes would reduce it, and none exist yet.
supplier.noDocuments: No documents on bills you may see.

bills.title: Supplier bills
bills.intro: Bills from suppliers. Approval, posting and settlement are shown apart: an approved bill is owed, not paid.
bills.searchHint: Reference, supplier invoice number, supplier or consumer number
bills.noneHint: Bills you may see appear here.

bill.title: Supplier bill
bill.rejectEffect: The bill is not owed and goes back to the person who prepared it. Your reason is kept in its history.
bill.cancelEffect: The bill is closed and can no longer be submitted or approved. Its history stays.
bill.postDisabled: Planned: posting waits on E.7's posting rules (decision E-⁠17).
bill.obligationBody: This bill is owed to the supplier. It is not posted and not paid; a payment instruction does not change what is owed.
bill.paymentsAfterApproval: A payment instruction can be prepared once the bill is approved.

newBill.title: New supplier bill
newBill.intro: Record a bill from a supplier. Every line names its cost centre. Saving makes a draft; someone else approves it.
newBill.supplierHint: Type part of the name. Only suppliers of this entity you may use are listed.
newBill.invoiceNoHint: As printed on the supplier's bill.
newBill.linesHint: Each line is charged to one cost centre and category.
newBill.readOnlyTitle: You can see bills but not record them
newBill.readOnlyBody: Recording supplier bills needs the supplier management permission.

payments.title: Supplier payment instructions
payments.intro: An instruction asks for a payment. It is approved by someone else and then marked sent (simulated). It is never settled here: settlement needs bank evidence (decision E-⁠18).
payments.noneHint: Instructions are prepared from approved bills.

payment.title: Payment instruction
payment.preparedToast: {{ref}} prepared: an instruction, not a payment
payment.instructionOnly: This only asks for a payment. No money moves and the bill stays owed in full until bank evidence settles it (decision E-⁠18).
payment.notSettledBody: No bank is connected and no transfer is made. The bill stays owed in full; settlement needs a matched debit line (decision E-⁠18).
payment.cancelEffect: The instruction is withdrawn. Its amount can be instructed again; the bill stays owed.

ledger.title: Supplier ledger
ledger.intro: What is owed to a supplier: approved bills, less credit notes and settled payments.
ledger.postingBody: Planned (E.7 posting rules, E-⁠17): no bill is posted to the general ledger yet.
ledger.limited: The supplier ledger needs every cost centre of the entity. It is withheld from you rather than shown in part.
ledger.noObligations: No approved bills: nothing is owed yet.
ledger.formula: Balance = approved bills − credit notes − settled payments. No credit note or settled payment exists yet.
ledger.awaitingHint: Not owed until approved; not part of the balance.
ledger.instructionsHint: Not settled: they do not reduce the balance.

utilities.title: Utility bills
utilities.intro: Electricity, water, gas and telephone bills of each site, recorded and approved like any supplier bill.
utilities.noAutoPayBody: Utility bills are never paid automatically. Each one is approved by a second person and paid only by an instruction.
utilities.noneHint: Utility bills you may see appear here.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.intro: Expenses and employee claims of the cost centres you may see. An approved expense is owed, not paid.
expenses.voucherRule: Where payables is licensed, expenses are recorded here, not as cash vouchers (the S.1 rule).
expenses.noneHint: Expenses of your cost centres appear here.

expense.title: Expense
expense.approveEffect: It becomes an obligation. Nothing is paid, posted or reimbursed.
expense.rejectEffect: It is not owed. Your reason is kept in its history.
expense.withdrawEffect: It leaves the approval queue and can no longer be submitted. Its history stays.
expense.obligationBody: This expense is owed. It is not posted and not paid (decisions E-⁠17 and E-⁠18).
expense.claimObligation: This claim is owed to the employee. It is not reimbursed: reimbursement waits on decision E-⁠18.
expense.noBudget: No budget you may open for {{year}}
expense.toBva: Budget vs actual for this cost centre

newExpense.title: New expense
newExpense.intro: Record an expense of one of your cost centres with its receipt. Someone else approves it.
newExpense.claimIntro: Record what a staff member spent for the organisation. Neither you nor the claimant can approve it.
newExpense.costCentreHint: Only your cost centres are listed.
newExpense.payeeHint: Who was or will be paid (as on the receipt).
newExpense.floatHint: The float of this cost centre.
newExpense.noFloat: This cost centre has no float you may use.
newExpense.readOnlyTitle: You can see expenses but not record them
newExpense.readOnlyBody: Recording expenses needs the expense permission for a cost centre.

approvals.title: Expense approvals
approvals.intro: Expenses and claims waiting for a decision. Nobody decides what they recorded, submitted or claimed.
approvals.toDecideHint: Approving makes it an obligation; nothing is paid.
approvals.noPermission: You can follow approvals here but not decide them.
approvals.waitingHint: Your own items, and items you may not decide.

employee.title: Employee expenses
employee.intro: Claims of staff members: what they spent for the organisation and what is owed back to them.
employee.reimbursementBody: An approved claim is owed to the employee. Reimbursement waits on decision E-⁠18; the link to the HR employee record arrives with E.14.
employee.noneHint: Claims of your cost centres appear here.

petty.title: Petty cash
petty.intro: Site and office cash floats. Only a count witnessed by a second person shows the cash on hand.
petty.noneHint: Floats of your cost centres appear here.
petty.unknown: Not known: no witnessed count yet.
petty.witnessEffect: You confirm you saw this cash counted. It becomes the evidence of cash on hand.
petty.disputeEffect: The count is not accepted as evidence. Your note is kept.
petty.topUpsHint: A top-⁠up is an instruction approved by someone else. No cash moves here.
petty.approveTopUpEffect: It becomes an approved instruction, not sent. The float's cash does not change.
petty.cancelTopUpEffect: The request is withdrawn. Nothing was paid.
petty.expensesHint: What the custodian accounts for at the next count.
petty.countRule: Count every note. A second person witnesses the count; until then it is not evidence of cash on hand.
petty.topUpRule: A top-⁠up asks for cash to bring the float back up, at most the authorised float ({{amount}}). Someone else approves it; nothing is paid here.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.intro: Budgets per cost centre and fiscal year (July to June). Each version is approved by someone else.
budgets.noneHint: Budgets of your cost centres appear here.

budget.title: Budget
budget.neverInPlace: Versions are never edited: a change is a new version, approved by someone else, which supersedes the approved one.
budget.approveEffect: It becomes the approved budget; the previously approved version is superseded.
budget.rejectEffect: The version is not used. Your reason is kept in the history.
budget.withdrawEffect: The version is closed without a decision. Its history stays.
budget.newVersionHint: Starts from the latest version. It replaces nothing until someone else approves it.

bva.title: Budget vs actual
bva.intro: Approved budgets against posted actuals, per cost centre and category.
bva.actualBody: Nothing can be posted until E.7's posting rules (decision E-⁠17), so posted actuals are zero. Approved bills and expenses are shown in their own column and are never counted as actual.
bva.commitments: Commitments from open purchase orders arrive with procurement (E.9).
bva.totalsWithheld: Entity totals need every cost centre of the entity in your scope.
bva.noneHint: Budget vs actual compares approved budget versions only. A version is approved by someone other than its preparer.
bva.billsExcluded: Approved supplier bills are not included: they need the supplier permission.
bva.withoutApproved: Cost centres without an approved budget

moneyStates.title: Money states, kept apart
moneyStates.approvedNote: An approved bill is an obligation. Nothing is paid.
moneyStates.postedNote: Posting is planned (E.7 posting rules, decision E-⁠17).
moneyStates.instructedNote: A payment instruction moves no money.
moneyStates.settledNote: Nothing is settled without matched bank evidence (decision E-⁠18).

balance.title: Balance on this bill
balance.actualNote: The supplier ledger's balance for this bill. An instruction never lowers it.
balance.simulationBody: If this instruction is later settled with bank evidence, {{amount}} would remain owed on this bill.
balance.simulationNot: A simulation only: nothing is paid or settled, and the actual balance stays {{actual}}.
balance.noSimulation: This instruction is cancelled, so there is nothing to simulate.
balance.checkMatches: Checked against the supplier ledger: the actual balance matches.
balance.checkDiffers: The actual balance does not match the supplier ledger. Do not act on this instruction; report it.

choose.bill: This page shows one supplier bill. Choose a bill from the bills list.
choose.expense: This page shows one expense or claim. Choose one from the expenses list.
choose.budget: This page shows one budget. Choose a budget from the budgets list.
